text:
Type: tall smoked glass bottle vase
Use: holding single stems or dried branches on a table, shelf or sideboard; living room, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: tinted glass, heavy clear base
Colors: smoky grey, darker charcoal at the base, translucent
Shape: tall cylindrical bottle with rounded shoulders, narrow neck and rolled flared lip, gradient tint that deepens toward the bottom, slim and elegant
Feel: calm, sleek, moody, refined
Goes with: dried grasses, eucalyptus, light or dark wood, concrete and linen; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.description: The glass vase is mouth blown by a skilled craftsperson.
